title: Chala pyaase gale par kund khanjar
body:
chala pyaase gale par kund khanjar
sada zainab ne di ye rabb e dawar
aye jaan e fatima o murtuza
huwe ghurbat me tum jo hamse juda
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha zainab ne apna peet ke sar
sar e maqtal hai zehra ka dulara
hazaro'n hai'n adu shabbir tanha
hai ek mazloom, har janib sitamgar
<<DIVIDER>>
akela ran me hai zehra ka pyaara
na koi saya na koi sahara
taras khata nahi koi bhi uspar
madad ka waqt hai abbas aao
<<DIVIDER>>
utho darya se bhai ko bachao
na so yu'n chain se shaane kata kar
jo teri yaad me roye sakina
jo maqtal me tujhe dhoonde sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
dilasa du'n usey akhir mai kyu'nkar
gire ghode se ran me ibne hyder
ali rote hain girya hai payambar
zibha karne ko jaate hai sitamgar
<<DIVIDER>>
behan qaime me ab tum laut jao
abhi zinda hoo'n na aansu bahao
kaha sheh ne ye sar sajde me rakh kar
qayamat laayi hai shame gharibaa'n
<<DIVIDER>>
haram ka ab nahi koi nighebaa'n
labo'n pe sab ke hai nouha ye anwar
